title: Stockfish, But It Copies Your Last Move Quality...
summary: Normal chess vs 'MirrorFish', a Stockfish variant (playable on iwantcheckmate.com) that copies the quality RANK of your last move: if you play Stockfish's best move it plays its best move, if you play your 2nd-best it plays its 2nd-best, and so on. The narrator plays deliberately bad moves that create threats (e.g. Bxf7+ which it can't simply recapture) so the engine must answer with equally bad moves, and wins his one game.
rules: Standard chess; player White vs MirrorFish.
After each player move, rank all of the player's legal moves by Stockfish eval; find the rank k of the move played.
MirrorFish then ranks its own legal moves by eval and plays its k-th best move (clamped to the number of legal moves).
